videos.headline: No. 2 Clemson makes easy work of Syracuse in 54-0 win
videos.description: Deshaun Watson throws for 169 yards and two touchdowns before leaving the game with a bruised shoulder in Clemson's 54-0 win over Syracuse to remain undefeated.

videos.headline: E. Dungey pass intercepted, R. Carter return  for 17 yds
videos.description: Eric Dungey pass intercepted Ryan Carter return for 17 yds to the Syrac 15

videos.headline: Watson rushes for first TD of the game
videos.description: Clemson quarterback Deshaun Watson takes the snap and rushes one yard in to the end zone for the touchdown.

videos.headline: Syracuse QB Eric Dungey leaves game with injury
videos.description: Eric Dungey run for 6 yds to the Syrac 29

videos.headline: Clemson LB Boulware suplexes Syracuse RB Strickland
videos.description: After the whistle is blown dead, Clemson LB Ben Boulware is flagged for a personal foul for suplexing Syracuse RB Dontae Strickland.

videos.headline: Watson finds Cain for 65-yard TD
videos.description: Clemson QB Deshaun Watson throws a deep pass complete to Deon Cain for a 65-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Watson connects with Williams for 14-yard TD
videos.description: Clemson quarterback Deshaun Watson fires a pass over the middle to Mike Williams who gets into the end zone for the 14-yard touchdown reception.

videos.headline: Clemson CB Tankersley picks off Syracuse QB Wilson
videos.description: Syracuse QB Austin Wilson throws a pass on the run that is intercepted by Clemson CB Cordrea Tankersley.

videos.headline: No Watson, no problem, Clemson keeps scoring
videos.description: Even with Deshaun Watson out of the game, Clemson keeps finding the end zone as Nick Schuessler hits Artavis Scott from five yards out to make it 30-0 Tigers.

videos.headline: Deon Cain makes his 2nd Touchdown catch of the game
videos.description: Nick Schuessler pass complete to Deon Cain for 18 yds for a TD

videos.headline: Crazy tipped pass turns into Clemson pick-six
videos.description: Clemson's defense hasn't allowed a point but decided to get in on scoring themselves when a wild tipped pass is picked off by Tanner Muse who goes 64 yards to the house for a touchdown making it 54-0 Tigers.
